name: com.talonbridge.gaze
description: Gaze input for Unity on macOS, sourced from a Tobii eye tracker through Talon over localhost UDP. Provides a gaze provider abstraction and debug tooling.

samples.description: Interchangeable dwell feedback components: radial fill, scale and outline.
Marker showing the estimated 3D gaze position from GazeWorldPointer.
URP shaders that react to gaze: a fullscreen pass, a 3D object material and a UI material.
